sources: Ukrinform -- 'EU to activate special emergency mechanism for Ukraine - Zelensky' (https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-polytics/4182833-eu-to-activate-special-emergency-mechanism-for-ukraine-zelensky.html), citing Zelenskyy'
fault_line: Emergency cash or emergency theatre? Kyiv's lights are out NOW -- does Brussels' mechanism arrive before winter does?

sections.what_happened: [PRIMARY-SOURCE CLAIM] After a call with European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen, Zelenskyy announced the EU agreed to activate a special emergency mechanism to quickly provide Ukraine with funding for power, water and heating: 'Right now, many of our cities and communities are facing a very difficult situation with power, water, and heating supplies due to Russian strikes. The situation is most difficult in Kyiv, the Dnipropetrovsk, Sumy, and Donetsk regions, and Kherson.' Teams already working on implementation. They also discussed additional energy/humanitarian aid for winter, EU integration, and coordinated positions for the Abu Dhabi meeting. [GAP, NOT A DISPUTE] Kyiv Post: Zelenskyy did not identify the mechanism by its formal name, specify the funding available, or announce a disbursement date.
sections.what_verified: 3 distinct tiered families: Ukrinform (T2, STATE UA), Ukrainska Pravda (T3), ANI (T1, via Tribune India).
sections.what_disputed: The announcement is a commitment, not cash: no mechanism name, no amount, no disbursement date (Kyiv Post). The energy crisis it addresses is strike-driven: Nov 2-3 attack knocked 3 DTEK plants offline; Nov 6 Zhytomyr strike worsened Kyiv supply; hourly outages for all resident categories (RBC-Ukraine).
sections.why_matters: Kyiv, Dnipro, Sumy, Donetsk, Kherson -- no power, no water, no heat. Brussels just switched on the emergency tap. But nobody will say how much, or when.
sections.context: Background: MISSED CATCH-UP -- EU to activate special emergency mechanism for fast-track funding of Ukraine's power, water and heating after Russian strikes (Zelenskyy-von der Leyen call, Nov 9)

totw_analysis: Our read: Kyiv, Dnipro, Sumy, Donetsk, Kherson -- no power, no water, no heat. Brussels just switched on the emergency tap. But nobody will say how much, or when. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Emergency cash or emergency theatre? Kyiv's lights are out NOW -- does Brussels' mechanism arrive before winter does?
